title: indigo_agent_scheduler: @observer, @pi and @project task header keys set OBSERVER, PI_NAME and PROPID FITS headers
description:
Owner request of 2026-11-17: frames taken for a particular group or project must be identifiable from their FITS headers.

Add three optional task header keys to the Scheduler Agent (indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler):
- @observer <text>  -> FITS keyword OBSERVER (standard FITS 4.0 keyword)
- @pi <text>        -> FITS keyword PI_NAME (as the owner asked; used by JWST and others)
- @project <text>   -> FITS keyword PROPID (proposal/project id, NOAO convention, widely recognised)

Parsing in indigo_agent_scheduler_header.c/.h: text value of 1-68 bytes (fits a FITS string value), no control characters; a repeated key follows the parser's existing duplicate rule. Applying in apply_context() of indigo_agent_scheduler.c: written through CCD_SET_FITS_HEADER of the Imager Agent with the existing fits_string() quoting, only when the task sets the key and the FITS item of AGENT_SCHEDULER_DATA is on, and removed in restore_context() together with SCHTASK/SCHRUN/SCHNIGHT; hooks follow the same path as tasks.

Tests: header parser unit tests (indigo_test/unit/test_agent_scheduler_header.c: valid values, quoting, empty, too long, control characters) and integration tests in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c (headers set before the run, absent when the key is not given or FITS is off, removed after the run, value with a quote).

Documentation: indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md (header key table, Observation data section) and indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md. Bump the scheduler agent driver version.

outcome.summary: Pass. Parser (indigo_agent_scheduler_header.c:295-308, 478-486) accepts 1-56 bytes after quote doubling, rejects control characters including 0x7f, and repeated keys via the existing rule; CR and trailing blanks are trimmed before. apply_context (indigo_agent_scheduler.c:1207-1214) sets OBSERVER, PI_NAME and PROPID only for keys present and with FITS on, via fits_string(); restore_context (1233-1238) removes exactly the ones set; hooks use the same path. Limit verified: indigo_ccd_driver.c:851 rejects values over 58 bytes including quotes and fits_string truncates content at 56, so 56 is the correct cap. Version bumped 0x03000010 to 0x03000011. Unit check passed on 89aa7cc197; I ran the test_agent_scheduler integration binary: 105/105 passed including the 5 new cases. Notes for the owner, not blocking: (1) the ticket text says 1-68 bytes; the implementation uses 56 (a quote counts as two) because of the CCD driver limit. This is a correct narrowing but deviates from the written criterion and is not recorded in a ticket note; the owner should confirm. (2) SCHEDULER.md:745 still says "the three keywords are removed" while the preceding bullet now says the data headers are removed too; wording only. (3) Docs say "characters" but the count is bytes; non-ASCII UTF-8 is accepted and written into FITS, which requires printable ASCII; same as the existing task-name path, out of scope.

Re-review after the SCHEDULER.md edit. Only change since 89aa7cc197 is SCHEDULER.md:745 (git diff 89aa7cc197 HEAD). The new sentence matches restore_context() (indigo_agent_scheduler.c:1220-1250): with context_fits set it always removes SCHTASK/SCHRUN/SCHNIGHT and removes OBSERVER/PI_NAME/PROPID only for bits in context_headers, i.e. only the headers apply_context() set from @observer/@pi/@project; DIR/OBJECT are restored. Consistent with SCHEDULER.md:743 ('removes exactly the headers it set') and INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md after-run paragraph. CCD_REMOVE_FITS_HEADER is the correct property name (indigo_names.h:245). Unit and whitespace checks passed at 365e997c77. No defects found.

history.text: Owner decisions 2026-11-17: key names @observer, @pi, @project (-> OBSERVER, PI_NAME, PROPID). After a run the scheduler always removes the keywords that the task set (same as SCHTASK); a keyword the task did not set is not touched.

Owner accepted 2026-11-17: value limit is 1-56 characters (a quote counts as two) instead of 1-68, because the CCD driver rejects CCD_SET_FITS_HEADER values over 58 characters including quotes. SCHEDULER.md removal sentence updated after review.
